title: Astrid and the Regiment
author: Petra Nystrom
blurb: Freya Montrose, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
